consequence.statement: Environments still using MirrorMaker 1 must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer, because MirrorMaker 1 support has been removed.
consequence.remediation: Migrate from MirrorMaker 1 to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46 removed support for MirrorMaker 1; users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence states the exposure in words (environments using MirrorMaker 1) but does not name the API kind, resource type, or configuration key that constitutes MirrorMaker 1 usage, so no static predicate can be written from the evidence alone.
